data.name: Wizard
data.description: [Not Implemented]A character who chooses wizard as his secondary class gains the following secondary class features.

raw_tokens.value: [Not Implemented]A character who chooses wizard as his secondary class gains the following secondary class features.
&nl;School: At 1st level, he chooses a school of magic in which to specialize. For all powers of that school, he treats his character level as his effective wizard level.
&nl;Familiar: At 3rd level, he gains a familiar, treating his character level as his effective wizard level.
&nl;School Power: At 7th level, he gains the 1st-level powers of his chosen school. If any of those powers grant an extra effect at 20th level, the character does not gain that extra effect.

&nl;Cantrip: At 11th level, if he has an Intelligence score of 10 or higher, he chooses a wizard cantrip from his chosen school and can cast that cantrip as a spell-like ability at will. He uses his character level as the caster level and Intelligence as the cantrip's key ability score.
&nl;Discovery: At 15th level, he gains an arcane discovery (Pathfinder RPG Ultimate Magic 86) or wizard bonus feat, treating his character level as his effective wizard level.
&nl;Greater School Power: At 19th level, he gains the 8th-level power of his chosen school.
